WFM moving to Nest

Audience: all agents · Goal: everyone runs their day on Nest (My WFM) · Fallback: the Nest – Support Platform Slack bot

1️⃣ The UI walkthrough (My WFM on Nest)

All of this lives under "My WFM" in the left sidebar after you log in on Nest. The home screen is your day at a glance: your Shift card, Today snapshot, a 7-day schedule strip, your leave summary, EDA slots, and a Quick actions panel.

1.1 Log in & sign in (start your shift)

  1. Open Nest and log in with your credentials.
  2. From the sidebar, go to My WFM.
  3. On the Shift card at the top, click Sign In when your shift starts.
    • This clocks you in, sets your Zendesk status to your scheduled channel's available status, and records your start time.
    • If you're late, it records the lateness — this is what attendance is measured from.
  4. Click Sign Out when your shift ends.
⚠️ Why this matters: lates, no-shows and deductions are now based on these Nest log-ins. Always sign in at your scheduled start.
📸 Screenshot: My WFM home — the Shift card with Sign In at the top.

1.2 Check your schedule (week or month)

  1. My WFM → Schedule (or the schedule strip on the home screen).
  2. Toggle Week / Month at the top.
    • Week — your shifts and off-days for the current week.
    • Month — the full month grid; use the arrows to go back/forward and Today to jump back.
  3. Each day shows your shift code and start–end times; off-days are marked.
📸 Screenshot: My schedule — Month view with the Week/Month toggle.

1.3 Leave: submit, check balances, check status

Submit a leave

  1. My WFM → Leave → New Leave (or the My Leaves quick action).
  2. Pick your leave type, set start/end dates, add a reason, and submit.
  3. Some types support half-day, custom hours, or a sick-note attachment — the form shows these when relevant.

Check your leave balance

  • My WFM → Leave shows your balances and usage, or My WFM → Leave → Policy for your entitlement.

Check if a leave was approved or rejected

  • My WFM → Leave → My Requests — every request shows its status (Pending / Approved / Rejected / Cancelled).
  • The home screen's Today card also lists pending leave requests at a glance.
📸 Screenshot: My Leaves — balances + request statuses (Pending / Approved / Rejected).

1.4 EDA: check what's open and claim it

Check open EDA / extra-duty slots

  • My WFM → EDA — published EDA slots with your eligibility.
  • The home screen shows your top EDA shifts directly.

Claim / opt in

  • My WFM → Open Shifts — browse unfilled shifts and Claim one (instant, first-come-first-served; you can't claim a day you're already scheduled).
  • For a published EDA slot, opt in — it goes to pending approval until the lead approves pay.
  • If you already worked extra hours not covered by a slot: My WFM → File an EDA (quick action).

1.5 Swaps: propose, marketplace, direct with an individual

Propose a swap (open to the marketplace)

  1. My WFM → Propose a swap (quick action).
  2. Pick the day you want to swap away. Leave the target open — it posts to the marketplace where anyone can take it (a lead has the final say).

Swap directly with a specific person

  • In the same Propose a swap form, search for the colleague you've already agreed with and name them. The swap applies the moment they accept — no further approval.

Check the marketplace

  • My WFM → Swap Marketplace — see open swap posts, offers made to you, and accept a match.
  • My WFM → My Bids — track your own proposals and accepted/placed bids.
📸 Screenshot: Swap Marketplace — open posts, offers to you, accept a match.
📸 Screenshot: Propose a swap — pick a day and target (marketplace or a specific person).

1.6 Shift adjustments

  • My WFM → Shift adjustment (quick action) — record a departmental move or a support-channel movement you worked (e.g. scheduled on chats but worked emails).
  • Also available: My WFM → File an EDA for extra hours, and My WFM → EDA to file Late Entry / Early Exit / One-Day Shift Swap adjustments.
  • Status of your adjustment requests is shown on My WFM → EDA → My Requests.

2️⃣ What's changing (the "before → now" story)

TaskBeforeNow
Leaves, balances, swaps, EDA, shift adjustmentsWFM Hub platformNest → My WFM
Checking your scheduleEmailNest → My WFM → Schedule
Attendance (lates, no-shows, deductions)Biometric loginsBased on your Nest log-in
WFM Hub itselfAvailableBeing closed

Key points to say out loud:

  • The WFM Hub is going away. All the self-service you did there now lives on Nest.
  • Schedules are no longer emailed. Check them on Nest.
  • Attendance is now tied to Nest log-ins. Signing in on time (and correctly) is how you stay accurate on the roster — lates, no-shows and deductions are measured from it.
  • This is the way forward. Nest is the single source of truth for your WFM day.

3️⃣ The Nest – Support Platform bot (Slack)

"You can do all of this through the Nest UI. But Nest runs on Tailscale, and if you're at home you might have trouble opening it from your phone or personal network. So we built you a backup: the Nest – Support Platform bot on Slack. Just chat with it and it will submit requests, check updates, and answer questions about all of the above — in plain English."

Quick start: type @Nest – Support Platform (or just ask "what can I do?") and the bot shows a guided menu with ready-to-type examples.

📸 Screenshot: The Nest – Support Platform guided menu after typing wfm.
What you wantAsk the bot
ScheduleWhat's my shift this week?
Leave balanceHow many casual leaves do I have left?
Submit leaveApply sick leave for tomorrow
Leave statusDid my leave get approved?
Cancel pending leaveCancel my Friday leave
Propose a swapI can't work Tuesday — ask someone to cover
Swap statusAny takers on my swap?
Accept a swapAccept the swap offered to me
Open shiftsAny open shifts I can grab? / Claim the Saturday open shift
EDAAny EDA slots this weekend? / Sign me up for Saturday EDA
Anything pending on youAnything waiting on me?

Rules to include:

  • The bot acts as you — it can't act for anyone else.
  • You confirm before it submits anything.
  • Only pending items can be cancelled by you — approved leaves and committed EDA sign-ups need a lead/manager.
  • The bot can't approve or override decisions — that's still WFM / your Team Lead.

5️⃣ Support & FAQ

  • "The bot says it can't do this." → Read the reason it gives — it usually means the item is already approved or in a state you can't change yourself.
  • "My sign-in didn't record / I was late." → Contact your Team Lead / WFM — attendance is now based on Nest log-ins, so fix it the same day.
  • "I can't open Nest from home." → Use the Nest – Support Platform bot on Slack for everything in this guide.
  • "Where's my schedule email?" → Schedules are no longer emailed. Check My WFM → Schedule (or ask the bot).
  • "When is the WFM Hub closing?" → 24 August, 11:59 PM — until then it still works, but Nest is the way forward.
